actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Create one NEW four-panel harness hardware details sheet, clean 2x2 layout with generous margins. Entirely freshly drawn Japanese hand-ink + hard CEL-color character-design technical illustration, pure white background, crisp dark weighted contours, matte charcoal webbing with limited flat hard shadows, gold/silver hardware only 2–3 solid tone planes. No photorealistic gradients, grain, chalk/white mottling, tiny scratches or soft 3D product shading. Keep intentional stitching and clean metal edges. Short plain English labels only as specified, no paragraphs or dimension numbers, no invented mechanisms or production ratings.
Image1 old20 defines gold shoulder adjuster, silver swivel hook and silver chest buckle. Image2 old21 defines the DIFFERENT black waist quick buckle. These are structural references only; remove soft rendered gradient style.
Panel1 label "01 ADJUSTER": one front GOLD rounded rectangular strap adjuster on black shoulder webbing, and beside it an oblique threading explanation showing the same webbing returning through the adjuster and tucked under a black keeper. No free long tail, no invented buckle prongs.
Panel2 label "02 HOOK": two separate states of ONE identical SILVER swivel snap hook, CLOSED attached to one lower belt anchor ring and OPEN gate for explanation. Hook upper rectangular strap bar, short swivel collar, hook body and inward-opening hinged gate are legible. Exactly one hook in each separate state; never chain two hooks together. Gold is not used here. The lower ring belongs to sewn black anchor webbing.
Panel3 label "03 CHEST": SILVER-faced center UNDERBUST release buckle on black webbing, one closed example and below one separated male+female pair. Preserve image1 shape: silver rectangular outer rails, black strap slots and black two-prong inner male clip. Only these two halves in the exploded state, no third duplicate center block. Clear compact hardware.
Panel4 label "04 WAIST": BLACK low-profile center WAIST release buckle from image2 on black belt, one closed example and below separated matching two black halves. Keep this visually BLACK/charcoal with limited gray hard-edge highlight; no silver outer frame or orange cover. Waist and chest buckles are unmistakably different.
Each panel is a separate illustration context. No quantity text or unsupported load/production claims, no extra hardware types, no straps crossing into neighboring panels. Closed/open drawings retain identical component geometry.

method: builtin imagegen; complete fresh drawing; byte-exact native; lossless WebP only
